audit_items.proof_trace: The property holds. `handle_borrow` unconditionally calls `refresh_obligation_borrow_interest_with_new_borrow` (L407) before `try_borrow_asset` (L412); this helper invokes the module-level `accrue_interest` on the borrow reserve in both cases — for an existing debt, via `refresh_obligation_borrow_interest` (which iterates all debts and calls `accrue_interest` per reserve), and for a new debt, via an explicit `accrue_interest` call on the new asset's reserve (L901). The freshened `borrow_index` is then read directly from the reserve (L410) and passed to `try_borrow_asset`, so stale-index exploitation is not possible. Not accruing collateral interest is a documented conservative design choice (comment L406) that understates collateral value and benefits the protocol.
